This layer is not enabled by default. Adding `CONFIG_MODEM_PIPE=y` will link the modem pipe library and resolve these errors.

This resolves compilation issues without needing the full PPP L2 subsystem, which this test does not use directly.

This approach resolves both the Kconfig warning and the linker errors by satisfying the build system's requirements while providing the necessary definitions for the code to compile correctly.
